name: Chi-square attack

technical_body.false_positive_notes: false-fires on smooth carriers (uniform gradients, near-monochrome regions); do not use as a single-probe verdict

notes: The original LSB-steganalysis test. Compares observed pair-of-values distribution to the null (untouched) distribution. Detects sequential LSB embedding; fails against random-traversal / matching / spread schemes.

name: RS analysis (Fridrich et al.)

technical_body.false_positive_notes: false-fires on noisy carriers; can differ from SPA on the same image (different assumptions)

notes: Smoothness-based. Groups pixels into Regular / Singular / Neutral flipping-behavior classes, exploits the fact that LSB replacement asymmetrically shifts those class populations.

name: Sample Pair Analysis (SPA)

technical_body.false_positive_notes: different failure modes than RS; a big SPA/RS mismatch usually means the embedding scheme isn't naive LSB replacement

notes: Pair-frequency-based. Complements RS: run both, compare, disagreement is a signal.

name: Bit-plane entropy

technical_body.output_semantics: Shannon entropy on a per-bit-plane basis; also visualizable as an image
technical_body.false_positive_notes: clean top bit-planes usually show structure; clean low bit-planes look near-random already

notes: Two uses: (1) numeric entropy per plane — low = uncompressed structured payload, high = encrypted/compressed; (2) render each plane as a black/white image ("visual attack") to spot payload boundaries.

name: F5 signature scan

technical_body.false_positive_notes: byte-scanner variant false-fires on random-looking data (e.g. encrypted payloads in unrelated files); PNG hits are almost always false positives since F5 is a JPEG tool

notes: Detects the F5 header signature in JPEG bytes. StegDetect implements this.

name: PVD difference-histogram analysis
notes: Looks for the tell-tale spikes / dips at PVD range boundaries in the pixel-difference histogram.
